exposure: low dose LNG-IUS (13.5 mg and 19.5 mg)
cohort: 109 women with a mean age of 39.8 ± 8.7 years old, prescribed LNG-IUS for contraception.
finding: The study found a differential use of available LNG-IUS in clinical practice, with different baseline characteristics and outcomes, primarily for bleeding patterns, but all systems were associated with a very high rate of satisfaction and continuation.
